scientific_integrity: The motivating article supplies the threshold occupation mean and Poisson comparison formula; those are credited. The new contribution is a threshold occupation-time Gaussian variance, closed symmetric formula, and sharp matched-reset-frequency ratio. The proof and supplied checker establish stated analytic and numerical claims; independent external audit, publication priority validation, and formal certification have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the continuous conservative natural-scale time-change diffusion with instantaneous resets at ±L, alpha>=0, and reset point x0 in [0,L). The strict event-frequency efficiency comparison is only for reset at the symmetry point, not for arbitrary reset location or equal energetic costs. Finite-time error bounds and stationary spatial equivalence are not claimed.
title: Sharp Gaussian occupation fluctuations under threshold resetting of sluggish diffusion
